title: A new AI Dream Girl Studio project joins chat
summary:
A small tuning day: a new chat project for creators, queue migration work, and a caching experiment returned to the workbench.

Chat projects gained AI Dream Girl Studio, giving people another ready-to-use creative space to build with.

The backend queue received migration and handling updates for Nebius, alongside formatting cleanup. Mostly plumbing, which is where software keeps its surprises.

Model-specific semantic caching with Vectorize was introduced and then reverted in the same stretch, keeping the production path clean while the approach gets another look.
